page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Italic verse in the body, then "Sc. S." right-aligned. Below that, a woodcut ornament with no text. At the foot, a signature mark.

l.i: Hoc haurienda fonte vobis est salus,
Postquam ille sanctæ gentis Augustus Deus

page.notes: The ornament below "Sc. S." is a woodcut decoration (a face with floral swags), not text, so it is not transcribed. "Augustus" is preceded by a small decorative sign in the print, which I have left out. "Iehonæ" and "Nomenq;" are read from a small italic type and may be imperfect. The stanza divisions are inferred from the indentation.
